guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：飛行時間質譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Time-of-flight mass spectrometers
guides.concept: 從同一電位加速後離子速度與質量平方根成反比出發，理解飛行時間質譜儀如何把質量量測轉成奈秒級計時，再把初始能量散布、反射器聚焦、微通道板偵測、時間數位轉換、溫度與高壓漂移造成的 ppm 誤差、MALDI 與 ESI 的離子注入整合成可驗收的質量量測鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the fact that ions accelerated through one potential travel at speeds inversely proportional to the square root of mass to see how a time-of-flight mass spectrometer turns mass measurement into nanosecond timing, then integrate initial energy spread, reflectron focusing, microchannel-plate detection, time-to-digital conversion, ppm errors from temperature and high-voltage drift, and MALDI and ESI ion injection into an acceptable mass-measurement chain.
procedure: 離子在電位差 U 中加速後獲得動能 zeU = ½mv²，進入長度 L 的無場漂移管等速飛行，到達偵測器的時間 t = L·√(m/(2zeU))，所以飛行時間與 √(m/z) 成正比。一次脈衝就讓所有質量同時出發，輕離子先到、重離子後到，偵測器只要記錄整段時間序列就得到完整質譜，這是飛行時間儀器沒有掃描、理論上質量範圍不受限的原因。代價是質量差距被壓縮成時間差：相鄰整數質量在高質量端只差數奈秒，整台儀器的本質是一個精密的碼表。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「加速區與無場漂移管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

解析力 m/Δm = t/(2Δt)，因為 m ∝ t²，時間的相對展寬會加倍成質量的相對展寬。Δt 來自多個獨立來源：離子形成位置與時間不同、初始速度與能量散布、雷射脈衝寬度、偵測器與電子計時抖動，各項以平方和相加。線性模式中能量散布 ΔU/U 直接造成 Δt/t = ½·ΔU/U，通常是最大項；1955 年 Wiley 與 McLaren 以雙段加速場做空間聚焦，並提出延遲萃取的前身「時間延遲聚焦」，讓位置與速度相關的散布在偵測器處互相抵消。MALDI 以 100–300 ns 的延遲萃取處理雷射羽流的初速分布，但無法消除所有能量散布。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子起始位置與能量散布」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

反射器是一組逐級升壓的環形電極，形成略高於加速電位的減速場；能量較高的離子跑得快，但穿入反射場較深、在裡面待較久，能量較低的離子路徑較短，兩者在偵測器處同時到達。1973 年 Mamyrin 提出此設計。單段均勻場反射器的一階能量聚焦條件是總無場長度 L 等於穿透深度 d 的四倍；雙段反射器以前段大幅減速、後段反射，可縮短長度並聚焦到二階。代價是柵網造成散射與穿透損失，以及離子必須走入反射場而限制了最大可接受的能量範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射器減速場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

到達的離子撞擊微通道板，通道內壁放出二次電子並在數 kV 偏壓下倍增，雙片 V 形堆疊的增益約 10⁶，輸出脈衝寬度小於 1 ns。脈衝可由時間數位轉換器（TDC）以 25–100 ps 的時間格記錄單一離子事件，或以每秒數 GS 的類比數位轉換器（ADC）記錄完整波形並累加；TDC 計時精細、雜訊低，但每個時間格每次脈衝只能計一次，ADC 動態範圍較大卻有基線雜訊。MCP 的偵測效率取決於離子撞擊速度，重離子速度低時效率明顯下降，所以大分子儀器常在偵測器前加後加速。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「微通道板與時間數位轉換器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

實際儀器以 t = t₀ + k·√(m/z) 校正：k 包含飛行長度與加速電壓，t₀ 包含觸發、纜線與電子延遲；高精度時還會加入高階項修正場的非理想。校正後的誤差主要來自兩種漂移：飛行管熱膨脹讓 L 改變，加速與反射器高壓的相對漂移讓 U 改變；由 m ∝ U·t²/L² 可知長度的相對變化在質量上加倍，而電壓的相對變化一比一進入質量。因此高解析儀器使用低膨脹材料與溫控飛行管、ppm 級穩定的高壓電源，並以持續注入的鎖定質量離子即時修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「t₀、k 校正與飛行管溫度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

質量準確度不只取決於校正，也取決於每個峰的質心能定得多準：對高斯峰，質心的標準差約為 (FWHM/2.355)/√N，N 是構成該峰的離子數，所以弱峰的質量本來就不準。TDC 系統在每次推送中每個時間格最多記一個離子，當平均到達數 μ 接近 1 時事件被漏記，觀察到的機率為 1 − e^(−μ)，強峰被壓扁、質心往早到的一側偏移；可用泊松修正 μ = −ln(1 − f) 還原，但在 f 接近 1 時失效。動態範圍因此受限於推送次數與飽和，ADC 或混合式採集與自動增益控制用來擴展。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「質心統計與死時間飽和」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

飛行時間分析器需要脈衝式的起點：MALDI 本身就是雷射脈衝，以 337 或 355 nm 雷射在基質晶體上每秒數百到上萬發，適合點樣與組織成像；ESI 產生連續離子流，必須先經離子導引與碰撞冷卻，再以正交加速推送器把一段離子束側向推入飛行管。正交加速的工作週期等於推送器長度除以每個推送週期內離子束前進的距離，與 √(m/z) 成正比；離子束的橫向速度散布在推送場中造成轉向時間 Δt = 2mΔv/(qE)，這是反射器無法修正的計時項。與液相層析耦合時，譜圖速率需在每個層析峰內取足夠點數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「正交推送器與離子源介面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

飛行時間質譜儀的驗收把前面的模型轉成固定測試：以標準品量各質量段的解析力（FWHM 定義），以多點校正與長時間鎖定質量量測驗證 ppm 準確度與漂移，以稀釋序列驗證線性與死時間修正，以已知同位素比例驗證偵測器飽和，以 MCP 單離子脈衝高度驗證增益，並以層析測試驗證取樣速率。交接紀錄須包含校正係數與殘差、飛行管溫度與高壓監測趨勢、MCP 電壓與累計計數、反射器與推送器電壓、鎖定質量設定，以及各項允收值，使任何一項劣化都能追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「解析力、質量準確度與線性的驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An ion accelerated through a potential difference U gains kinetic energy zeU = ½mv², then coasts through a field-free drift tube of length L and reaches the detector at t = L·√(m/(2zeU)), so flight time scales with √(m/z). One pulse launches all masses together, light ions arriving first and heavy ions later, and recording the whole time trace yields a complete spectrum, which is why time-of-flight instruments need no scanning and have an essentially unlimited mass range. The price is that mass differences are compressed into time differences: adjacent integer masses at high mass differ by only a few nanoseconds, so the instrument is at heart a precision stopwatch. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceleration region and field-free drift tube”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Resolving power is m/Δm = t/(2Δt) because m ∝ t², so a relative time spread doubles into a relative mass spread. Δt comes from independent contributions added in quadrature: differences in formation position and time, initial velocity and energy spread, laser pulse width, and detector and electronic timing jitter. In linear mode an energy spread ΔU/U produces Δt/t = ½·ΔU/U directly and is usually the largest term; in 1955 Wiley and McLaren used a two-stage acceleration field for space focusing and introduced time-lag focusing, the forerunner of delayed extraction, so position- and velocity-correlated spreads cancel at the detector. MALDI uses 100–300 ns of delayed extraction to handle the initial velocity distribution of the laser plume, but cannot remove every energy spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Initial ion position and energy spread”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A reflectron is a stack of ring electrodes graded in voltage to form a retarding field slightly above the acceleration potential; faster, higher-energy ions penetrate deeper and spend longer inside, slower ions take a shorter path, and both reach the detector together. Mamyrin proposed the design in 1973. A single-stage uniform-field reflectron achieves first-order energy focusing when the total field-free length L equals four times the penetration depth d; a two-stage reflectron decelerates strongly in the first stage and reflects in the second, shortening the device and focusing to second order. The costs are scattering and transmission loss on grids and a limited accepted energy window, since every ion must turn around inside the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflectron retarding field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Arriving ions strike a microchannel plate, whose channel walls emit secondary electrons that multiply under a bias of a few kilovolts; a two-plate chevron stack gives a gain of about 10⁶ and output pulses narrower than 1 ns. Pulses are either recorded by a time-to-digital converter (TDC) as single-ion events in 25–100 ps bins or digitised as full waveforms by an analogue-to-digital converter (ADC) running at several gigasamples per second and summed; the TDC offers fine timing and low noise but counts at most once per bin per pulse, while the ADC has more dynamic range but baseline noise. MCP detection efficiency depends on impact velocity and drops markedly for slow heavy ions, so large-molecule instruments often post-accelerate ions in front of the detector. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Microchannel plate and time-to-digital converter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Real instruments calibrate with t = t₀ + k·√(m/z), where k contains flight length and acceleration voltage and t₀ contains trigger, cable and electronic delays; high-accuracy work adds higher-order terms for non-ideal fields. After calibration the errors come mainly from two drifts: thermal expansion of the flight tube changes L, and relative drift of the acceleration and reflectron high voltages changes U; since m ∝ U·t²/L², a relative length change doubles in mass while a relative voltage change enters mass one to one. High-resolution instruments therefore use low-expansion, temperature-controlled flight tubes, ppm-stable high-voltage supplies and a continuously infused lock-mass ion for real-time correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “t₀, k calibration and flight-tube temperature”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mass accuracy depends not only on calibration but on how well each peak centroid is defined: for a Gaussian peak the centroid standard deviation is about (FWHM/2.355)/√N with N the number of ions in the peak, so weak peaks are intrinsically less accurate. A TDC system records at most one ion per time bin per push, so as the mean arrival number μ approaches 1 events are lost and the observed probability is 1 − e^(−μ); strong peaks are flattened and their centroids shift toward earlier arrival. Poisson correction μ = −ln(1 − f) restores them but fails as f approaches 1, so dynamic range is limited by push count and saturation, and ADC or hybrid acquisition with automatic gain control extends it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Centroid statistics and dead-time saturation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A time-of-flight analyser needs a pulsed start: MALDI is inherently pulsed, firing a 337 or 355 nm laser at matrix crystals hundreds to tens of thousands of times per second, suited to spotted samples and tissue imaging; ESI produces a continuous ion stream that must pass through ion guides and collisional cooling before an orthogonal-acceleration pusher kicks a segment of the beam sideways into the flight tube. The orthogonal duty cycle equals the pusher length divided by the distance the beam advances per push period and scales with √(m/z); the beam's transverse velocity spread in the push field creates a turnaround time Δt = 2mΔv/(qE), a timing term the reflectron cannot correct. Coupled to liquid chromatography, the spectral rate must give enough points across every chromatographic peak. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Orthogonal pusher and ion-source interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of a time-of-flight mass spectrometer turns the earlier models into fixed tests: standards measure FWHM resolving power across mass ranges, multipoint calibration and long lock-mass runs verify ppm accuracy and drift, dilution series verify linearity and dead-time correction, known isotope ratios verify detector saturation, single-ion MCP pulse heights verify gain, and chromatographic tests verify sampling rate. The handoff record must contain calibration coefficients and residuals, flight-tube temperature and high-voltage trends, MCP voltage and accumulated counts, reflectron and pusher voltages, lock-mass settings and each allowance, so that any degradation can be traced. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance table of resolution, accuracy and linearity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把質量與時間當成線性關係做內插，或忽略觸發延遲 t₀，整個質量軸在高低端各自彎曲，低質量碎片與高質量前驅物的指認同時出錯；漂移管的屏蔽網破損或絕緣表面帶電讓區域不再無場，離子速度在途中改變，峰形拖尾且位置隨使用時間漂移。
空調週期讓實驗室溫度擺動 ±0.5 K，未溫控的鋁飛行管產生 ±23 ppm 的週期性質量誤差，代謝物以 5 ppm 窗口搜尋資料庫時一半以上的正確化合物被排除；鎖定質量離子被樣品中的同質量干擾污染，修正把整段資料往錯誤方向拉偏。
pitfallsEn: Interpolating mass as linear in time or ignoring the trigger delay t₀ bends the mass axis differently at the low and high ends, mis-assigning both low-mass fragments and high-mass precursors; a damaged screening mesh or charged insulating surfaces leave the drift tube no longer field-free, changing ion speed in flight so peaks tail and wander with use.

Air-conditioning cycles swing the laboratory ±0.5 K and an uncontrolled aluminium flight tube produces periodic ±23 ppm mass errors, so a metabolite database search with a 5 ppm window rejects more than half of the correct compounds; a lock-mass ion contaminated by an isobaric sample interference pulls the whole data set the wrong way.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 飛行時間質譜儀
history.text: 1946 年賓州大學的 William Stephens 提出飛行時間質量分析的構想，1955 年 Bendix 公司的 Wiley 與 McLaren 發表雙段加速的空間聚焦與時間延遲聚焦，奠定商用儀器的基礎。1973 年 Mamyrin 在列寧格勒提出反射器，大幅提升解析力；1980 年代後期 Karas 與 Hillenkamp 以及島津製作所的田中耕一發展出基質輔助雷射脫附游離（MALDI），田中與電灑游離的 John Fenn 共同獲得 2002 年諾貝爾化學獎；正交加速讓連續的電灑離子源也能接上飛行時間分析器，今日的四極—飛行時間與多次反射式儀器已是蛋白質體與代謝體研究的主力。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1946 William Stephens of the University of Pennsylvania proposed time-of-flight mass analysis, and in 1955 Wiley and McLaren of the Bendix Corporation published two-stage space focusing and time-lag focusing, the basis of commercial instruments. In 1973 Mamyrin in Leningrad proposed the reflectron, greatly raising resolving power; in the late 1980s Karas and Hillenkamp, and Koichi Tanaka at Shimadzu, developed matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionisation (MALDI), and Tanaka shared the 2002 Nobel Prize in Chemistry with John Fenn of electrospray ionisation; orthogonal acceleration let continuous electrospray sources feed time-of-flight analysers, and today quadrupole–time-of-flight and multi-reflecting instruments are workhorses of proteomics and metabolomics. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「飛行時間方程與質量尺度」到「儀器驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "The flight-time equation and the mass scale" through "Instrument acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
